messages:
anya: Anyone else performing the weekly YAML blessing ritual? 🙏 We've got a culprit block that'll refuse to parse unless toasted.

matt: show the offending snippet pls

anya: ```yaml
service:
  name: my-service
  version: 1.0
  dependencies:
    - lib: true
```

sanjay: omg `- lib: true` is the YAML whisperer's banned dance. :joy:

lucy: That dash-with-map pattern always confuses linters. Either make it a proper list of scalars or a map: e.g. `dependencies: { lib: true }` or `- name: lib`

matt: Also semver offended by `version: 1.0` — the compiler sighed and asked for `v1.0.0`.

dev-bot: lint-result: failed — line 5: sequence item not followed by hyphenated block. See https://yaml-spec.example/indentation-for-broken-hearts

anya: proposal: add a pre-commit hook called `yml-bless` that runs prettier/yaml and then we all offer a 👍 to the repo guardian.

ops-bot: poll: add `scripts.yml_bless` to root? react :+1: to opt in, :thumbdown: to decline. (poll expires in 24h)

lucy: :+1: definitely. saves future midnight screams.

sanjay: :-1: (jk) I'll do it if someone promises to fix my broken semver dating profile later. :kissing_heart:

matt: performed the ritual. Pushed a tiny fix and bumped to `v1.0.0` — compiler stopped yelling. :tada:

anya: championing the tiny wins. thanks y'all. I'm leaving an incantation comment in the repo: `# blessed-by: team-random` :sparkles:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: note: no infra changes detected. Carry on. :robot_face:
